name: Peanut M&M's / Snickers Bar (Whole Peanut Stricture Warning)
whyItWorks: Peanut M&M's and Snickers bars contain whole and split roasted peanuts encased in candy and chocolate. Incomplete chewing leaves hard, jagged peanut halves that can obstruct strictured bowel segments.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Stricture Warning: Avoid candies with whole roasted peanuts or tree nuts. Choose Plain M&M's or smooth chocolate bars instead.
watchOuts: Hard unchewed peanut pieces pose a direct mechanical obstruction hazard in narrowed bowel sections.
